name: Getting Back to Work
description: Bring a basic laboratory analysis kit to the cabin chemist for 10 Merch.  Look in laboratories and other scientific facilities.

dialogue.describe: I need a basic laboratory analysis kit.
dialogue.offer: I saved some equipment when I left the city, but I still need a reliable way to take measurements and check my results.  Bring me a basic laboratory analysis kit and I'll pay you 10 Merch.
dialogue.advice: One of those old labs might have one.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Here's your 10 Merch.  Now I can take a proper look at those odd samples I found.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll have to find it myself.

name: Strange Research
description: Recover the mutation trial records from the marked lab's first basement and return them to the chemist for a dose of mutagen and a dose of purifier.

dialogue.describe: I found a reference to some strange trials at an old lab.
dialogue.offer: Some notes with those samples mention compounds that changed the subjects' bodies.  I want to see the actual trial records.  Bring them back and you can have one dose each of the mutagen and purifier I salvaged with the notes.
dialogue.accepted: I've marked the lab's first basement.  Check the desk in the office on the west side.
dialogue.advice: Bring a light.  Look for the west office next to the basement's central lounge.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find the trial records?
dialogue.success: The trials were real.  Different compounds pushed people toward different kinds of changes, and an injection wasn't just a stronger drink.  Here's the mutagen and purifier I promised.  You don't have to take either.  Ask me before you try them if you want to know what the records say.
dialogue.failure: Then all I've got are fragments.  Pity.

name: The Alpha Project
description: Retrieve the sealed Alpha sample case from the marked lab's security wing on basement level five.  Return it to the chemist for two doses of Alpha serum.

dialogue.describe: The records point to another project, called Alpha.
dialogue.offer: The Alpha team tried to improve human abilities without the more drastic changes in the other trials.  The records say they kept a sealed sample case in a deep security wing.  Bring it back and I'll give you two doses of Alpha serum from the case.  Don't go in unprepared.  That wing was built to keep people out.
dialogue.accepted: I've marked the security wing on the fifth basement level.  Look in the secure room on the east side.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you.  This isn't worth dying for.
dialogue.advice: Bring a light and a way through secured doors, and leave yourself a way out.
dialogue.success: The seals held.  I'll keep a little material to study, but these two doses are yours.  This is what the Alpha team made; I couldn't reproduce it here.
dialogue.success_lie: I need the sealed case, not a description.
dialogue.failure: Then we'll have to make do with the records.

description: A folder of trial observations and cross-references to other research projects.
A rigid specimen case with intact seals and a faded Alpha Project inventory label.
